# Constructor Point2D

#### Point2D(double, double)

Initializes a new instance of the Point2D structure with its coordinates.

##### Declaration

```
public Point2D(double inX, double inY)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  double |  inX |  X coordinate.  |  
 
|  double |  inY |  Y coordinate.  |
